avr-notecpp.comment: Style 1: typed API groups via Api<UnstructuredCtx, StaticNotecard<SerialStack>>. The most common StaticNotecard usage. Grew from 25,198 during the spike/transport-byte-channel refactor (IByteTransport + ITransact split, JSONB+tree orthogonality).

avr-notecpp-direct.comment: Style 2: nc.execute(req) bypassing the Api groups. Drops a layer of group thunks. Grew from 24,788 during the transport refactor.

avr-notecpp-raw.comment: Style 3: transact_dispatch(RequestSource, ...) raw entry — bypasses StaticNotecard entirely. Grew from 21,172 during the transport refactor (BuildFn → RequestSource API change).

avr-notecpp-multistack.comment: Stack-type comparison build: NOTECPP_MULTISTACK_USE picks one stack (A=HardwareSerial default, B=mock); only the selected stack's Notecard, arena, and Api instances are linked. Reflects what a real single-Notecard app pays for each stack configuration. AB instantiates both for host-side codegen-sharing measurements and overflows AVR flash.
